title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Deductibles, Loss Settlement and Extensions by Tier
content:
The coverage terms of a **Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs** certificate are set by its tier.

## Terms of the schedule
- **Building deductible:** building deductible per loss on a certificate.
- **Contents deductible:** contents deductible per loss on a certificate (0 where unavailable).
- **Building settlement:** basis for building losses.
- **Contents settlement:** basis for contents losses.
- **Increased Cost of Compliance:** Increased Cost of Compliance coverage on a certificate (0 = not included).
- **Loss of use:** whether additional living expense or business income is covered.
- **Basement contents:** whether contents in a basement are covered.

| Tier | Building deductible | Contents deductible | Building settlement |
|---|---|---|---|
| Lender-Placed Flood – Residential Mandatory Amount | 1250 dollars | 0 dollars | Actual cash value |
| Lender-Placed Flood – Residential Gap | 1250 dollars | 0 dollars | Actual cash value |
| Lender-Placed Flood – Residential Replacement Cost | 2500 dollars | 0 dollars | Replacement cost |
| Lender-Placed Flood – Manufactured Home | 1250 dollars | 0 dollars | Actual cash value |
| Lender-Placed Flood – Commercial Building | 5000 dollars | 0 dollars | Actual cash value |
| Lender-Placed Flood – Commercial Building and Contents | 5000 dollars | 5000 dollars | Actual cash value |

| Term common to every tier | Value |
|---|---|
| Contents settlement | Actual cash value |
| Increased Cost of Compliance | 0 dollars (not included) |
| Loss of use | Not covered |
| Basement contents | Not covered |

## Points of judgement
- *On which tier is a building loss taken at replacement cost?* Only Lender-Placed Flood – Residential Replacement Cost; every other tier takes the building loss at actual cash value.
- *Does any tier include loss of use or basement contents?* No tier does.
